title: Dermatlas MAF and QC pipeline parameters
description: This pipeline uses Nextflow to filter and QC variant calls for dermatlas. The JSON Schema was built using the nf-core pipeline schema builder.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

subcohorts.description: Map of subcohort names to their configuration. Each subcohort should have a sample_list property pointing to a TSV file with tumor-normal pairs.

run_signatures.description: Run SigProfilerExtractor per subcohort downstream of QC.

sigprofiler_outdir.description: Publish directory for SigProfiler outputs. Separate from `outdir` so signature results can live alongside (not inside) the variants_combined tree — DERMATLAS convention: `${PROJECT_DIR}/analysis/sigprofiler`.

sigprofiler_seed.description: Optional SigProfiler Seeds.txt for reproducible re-runs.

sigprofiler_subcohort_names.description: Map of subcohort key → legacy publish-dir name for SigProfiler outputs (e.g. onePerPatient → one_tumour_per_patient). Unmapped keys fall back to the raw key.

run_dndscv.description: Run dNdScv significantly-mutated-gene discovery per subcohort downstream of QC.

dndscv_outdir.description: Publish directory for dNdScv outputs. Separate from `outdir` so dNdScv results can live alongside (not inside) the variants_combined tree — DERMATLAS convention: `${PROJECT_DIR}/analysis/dndscv`.

dndscv_refdb.description: Path to the dNdScv reference CDS .rda file (e.g. RefCDS_human_GRCh38_GencodeV18_recommended.rda). Required when run_dndscv = true.

dndscv_covariates.description: Optional path to a covariates .rda file. When set, dNdScv is run twice per subcohort (with and without covariates); when unset, only the without-covariates mode is run.

dndscv_merge_by_patient.description: If true, variants from sibling tumours sharing a PDXXXX patient prefix are merged prior to running dNdScv.

dndscv_subcohort_names.description: Map of subcohort key → legacy publish-dir name for dNdScv outputs (e.g. onePerPatient → one_tumour_per_patient). Unmapped keys fall back to the raw key.

run_oncodrivefml.description: Run OncodriveFML positive-selection analysis per subcohort downstream of QC.

oncodrivefml_outdir.description: Publish directory for OncodriveFML outputs. DERMATLAS convention: `${PROJECT_DIR}/analysis/oncodrivefml`.

oncodrivefml_seed.description: RNG seed passed to `oncodrivefml --seed` for reproducible sampling.

oncodrivefml_exclude_samples.description: Optional single-column list of SAMPLE IDs to drop before running OncodriveFML.

oncodrivefml_bgdata_dir.description: Path to the bgdata local_repository (per-chromosome genome reference tree, ~80 GB). Accessed via bind-mount; not staged. Required when run_oncodrivefml = true.

oncodrivefml_bgcache_dir.description: Path to the bgdata cache1 directory. Accessed via bind-mount; not staged. Required when run_oncodrivefml = true.

oncodrivefml_cadd_tabix.description: Path to the CADD SNV tabix file (e.g. CADD_v1.7_GRCh38_whole_genome_SNVs.tsv.gz). The matching .tbi is expected alongside. Required when run_oncodrivefml = true.

oncodrivefml_elements_bed.description: Path to the genomic elements BED that defines the regions tested for positive selection. Required when run_oncodrivefml = true.

oncodrivefml_subcohort_names.description: Map of subcohort key → legacy publish-dir name for OncodriveFML outputs (e.g. onePerPatient → one_tumour_per_patient). Unmapped keys fall back to the raw key.
